input.command:
sed -i 's/echo "Hello!"/echo "Hello, $1!"/' src/greet.sh
cat > bin/greet <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
# greet: print a greeting for one name.
set -eu
here=$(dirname "$0")
. "$here/../src/greet.sh"
upper=no
case "${1:-}" in
    --upper) upper=yes; shift ;;
    --help) echo "usage: greet [--upper] [NAME]"; exit 0 ;;
esac
name=${1:-world}
greeting=$(say_hello "$name")
if [ "$upper" = yes ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$greeting" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'
else
    printf '%s\n' "$greeting"
fi
SH
chmod +x bin/greet
sh bin/greet --upper Ada
